name: emc2
description: npm workspace root of the emc2 web client and of the plugins' web parts (CR-0006). Root build file, owned by the MCA. Every plugins/<id>/web is a workspace through the glob below (package name @emc2/plugin-<id>), so plugin web parts need no line here. The lock file next to it is generated: commit the regenerated file, never edit it by hand.
